title: Home Mining Weekly #1
subject: Home Mining Weekly #1: this week's best miner prices
preheader: Best home miner prices this week, 3 new miners, and solo vs pool in 30 seconds.
intro: Welcome to the first Home Mining Weekly. Each week: the best prices we found on home Bitcoin miners, what's new on the site, and one quick explainer. Two minutes, tops.

new_miners.name: Hammer Miner Thor P2

explainer.title: Solo vs pool, in 30 seconds
paras: Solo is a lottery ticket. Your miner tries to win a whole Bitcoin block on its own. If it wins, it gets the full reward. Most of the time it gets nothing, and for a home miner the odds are tiny.

Pool is a small, steady trickle. Thousands of miners share the work and split each reward, so you get small, regular payouts. They go up and down with Bitcoin's price and the network, so nobody can promise an amount.
Same miner, either way: it's just a setting. Small Bitaxes usually go solo for the long shot. Heater miners usually go pool.
